createNote.name: createNote
createNote.description: Create a note on a screen in Zeplin

x.description: The x coordinate position of the note on the screen

y.description: The y coordinate position of the note on the screen

x_start.description: The starting x coordinate for range selection (optional)

y_start.description: The starting y coordinate for range selection (optional)

aiMetadata.description: Add a comment/annotation note pinned to a specific position on a Zeplin screen, identified by project ID and screen ID. Use to leave design feedback or markup at given X/Y coordinates with a chosen highlight color. Not idempotent: each call creates a new note even with identical content.

findProject.name: findProject
findProject.description: Find a project by name or retrieve all projects

projectName.description: Optional project name to search for (partial match)

aiMetadata.description: Look up Zeplin projects accessible to the authenticated user. With a project name it filters to partial (case-insensitive) name matches; with the name left empty it returns all projects. Use to resolve a project ID before screen or note operations. Read-only and idempotent. Note: if the name filter matches nothing, it falls back to returning all projects.

findScreen.name: findScreen
findScreen.description: Find a screen by name or retrieve all screens in a project

screenName.description: Optional screen name to search for (partial match)

aiMetadata.description: List screens within a given Zeplin project (by project ID). With a screen name it filters to partial (case-insensitive) title matches; with the name left empty it returns all screens in the project. Use to resolve a screen ID before creating notes or updating a screen. Read-only and idempotent. Note: if the name filter matches nothing, it falls back to returning all screens.

updateProject.name: updateProject
updateProject.description: Update a project's name and description

name.description: The new name for the project

description.description: The new description for the project

aiMetadata.description: Update a Zeplin project's name and/or description, identified by project ID. Only the fields you supply are changed; omitted fields are left untouched. Use to rename a project or revise its description. Idempotent: repeating the call with the same values leaves the project in the same state.

description.description: The new description for the screen

aiMetadata.description: Set the description of a specific Zeplin screen, identified by project ID and screen ID. Use to revise the textual description shown for a screen. Idempotent: repeating the call with the same description leaves the screen in the same state.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

newNote.name: newNote
newNote.description: Triggered when a new note is created on a screen

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new note (comment/annotation) is added to a screen in a Zeplin project, delivering the note plus its project and screen context. Requires the corresponding webhook to be configured in the Zeplin dashboard.

project.name: HAL 9000
project.description: UI designs for the onboard computer on the spaceship Discovery 1

newScreen.name: newScreen
newScreen.description: Triggered when a new screen is created in a project

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new screen is added to a Zeplin project, delivering the screen details plus its project context. Requires the corresponding webhook to be configured in the Zeplin dashboard.
